1. Perform a lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedure. 2. Inspect all external hydraulic lines for leaks. 3. Perform a pressure test on the main cylinder to check for internal bypassing. 4. Check hydraulic fluid condition and filter integrity. 5. If pressure remains unstable, replace main cylinder seal kit and inspect pump assembly.

1. Perform a lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) procedure immediately. 2. Inspect hydraulic lines and fittings for external leaks. 3. Perform a pressure decay test on the main cylinder. 4. Check hydraulic fluid condition for signs of metal particulates (pump wear). 5. Replace main cylinder seals and inspect pump assembly.

1. Perform a vibration analysis to confirm bearing frequency signatures. 2. Inspect the spindle lubrication system for flow blockages or contamination. 3. Check for physical play in the spindle assembly. 4. If wear is confirmed, replace bearings and recalibrate spindle balance.

Perform a pressure test on the main hydraulic circuit to isolate the leak location. Inspect hydraulic lines for external weeping, and check pump output pressure against specifications. If pressure loss persists, disassemble the main cylinder to inspect and replace internal seals.

Perform a vibration analysis to confirm bearing health. Check lubrication levels and inspect for debris. If vibration persists after lubrication, initiate a teardown to inspect bearing wear patterns and verify spindle runout.

1. Immediately lock out/tag out (LOTO) the machine. 2. Perform a visual inspection of all external hydraulic lines and fittings for leaks. 3. Test pump output pressure against manufacturer specifications. 4. If external lines are sound, proceed with cylinder tear-down to inspect internal seals and piston condition.

1. Immediately lock out the machine (LOTO). 2. Inspect all external hydraulic lines for leaks. 3. Perform a pressure decay test on the main cylinder. 4. If decay is present, proceed with replacing the primary piston seals and inspecting the cylinder bore for scoring.

Perform a visual inspection of all hydraulic lines for external leaks. Check pump output pressure against the specification sheet. If pump output is normal, isolate the main cylinder to check for internal bypass/seal failure. Replace degraded seals and inspect hydraulic fluid for contamination.

Perform a lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) procedure. Inspect all visible hydraulic lines for external leaks. If no external leaks are found, conduct a pressure decay test on the main cylinder to confirm internal bypass leakage and replace cylinder seals.

1. Perform a lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) procedure. 2. Inspect all external hydraulic hoses and fittings for visible leaks. 3. Perform a pressure decay test on the main cylinder. 4. If no external leaks are found, disassemble the main cylinder to inspect and replace piston seals.
Perform a systematic inspection of hydraulic lines for external leaks, verify pump output pressure, and conduct a pressure decay test on the main cylinder to confirm internal seal integrity.

Perform a pressure test on the main hydraulic circuit. Inspect all external high-pressure lines for leaks. If external lines are sound, perform a cylinder drift test to confirm internal seal integrity. If internal leakage is confirmed, proceed with a full seal kit replacement and inspect the hydraulic pump for wear.

Perform a lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedure immediately. Inspect all high-pressure hydraulic lines for external leaks. If no external leaks are found, conduct a pressure decay test on the main cylinder to confirm internal seal failure. Check pump output pressure against the specification sheet.

Immediately stop high-speed operations. Inspect spindle bearings for pitting or excessive play, verify current lubrication levels and quality, and perform a dynamic balance test on the spindle assembly.

1. Immediately lock out/tag out (LOTO) the machine. 2. Perform a visual inspection of all external hydraulic lines for leaks. 3. Use a calibrated pressure gauge to test pump output pressure. 4. If pump pressure is nominal, perform a cylinder drift test to confirm internal seal bypass.

Perform a comprehensive inspection of the main cylinder seals and hydraulic lines for external leaks. Verify hydraulic pump output pressure against manufacturer specifications and check fluid condition/viscosity.

Perform a systematic inspection of hydraulic lines for external leaks. Conduct a pressure test on the main hydraulic pump. If pump output is nominal, proceed to disassemble the main cylinder to inspect internal seals for wear or thermal damage.

Perform a lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedure. Inspect all hydraulic hoses and fittings for external leaks. If no external leaks are found, conduct a pressure decay test on the cylinder to verify internal seal integrity. Inspect the hydraulic pump output pressure against the manufacturer's specifications.

Perform a visual inspection of all external hydraulic hoses and fittings for leaks. Use a pressure gauge to test pump output pressure. If external lines are sound, proceed to inspect the main cylinder seals for bypass leakage.

1. Perform an immediate lockout/tagout procedure. 2. Conduct a visual inspection of all hydraulic lines and fittings for leaks. 3. Perform a pressure drop test on the main cylinder to confirm internal bypass. 4. Inspect and replace cylinder seals if internal leakage is confirmed.

Perform a lockout/tagout procedure. Inspect hydraulic lines for external leaks. Verify pump output pressure with a calibrated gauge. If pump pressure is within spec, proceed to inspect the main cylinder seals for bypass leakage.
